songs.title: Chariot
lyrics: I can see it (he broke your heart)
I can see it (he broke your heart)
I can see it on your pretty face
I can see it (he broke your heart)
I can see it (he broke your heart)
I can see it on your pretty face
And fly like a loaded gun
(He broke your) You only like the bad boys
(He broke your heart) I can see it on your pretty face
(He broke your heart) I could be that new toy
(He broke your heart) I could be that heartbreak
Washed up in the city of sin singing
Washed up in the city of sin singing
Washed up in the city of sin singing
Or are you just a restless soul
That's not my kind of love
I race for fame and fun
The secret is when to know

songs.title: Digital Dreams
lyrics: I was born in a room with flourescent lights
Raised to be kind and afraid of heights
But they always seemed to find me
At night, out on the ledge
Catching glimpses of the strange fruit
Where do you go in the darkness
When you're alone in your bed
I worked the same job everybody had
And they said I was special
Why can't we seem to get along
Why does every road I take to leave just bring me home
And why does the journey feel so lonely
Will these questions matter when we're gone

songs.title: Love is an Ocean
lyrics: I move slowly in the haze of people posing like the sun
Under glowing eyes of neon skies spinning in slow motion
Let it carry me to you
And our life back at the surface has us struggle through our days
But when sun bursts on the water I feel longing to escape

songs.title: Shadowverse
lyrics: May he rise in the end
He's always hanging from the same rope
When you're up on the wire
And you can't hold the tension
As she cries on the phone
And you can't hold the tension
